value.rationale: The exact choice of aperiodicization on a natural family of meeting/search networks exhibits a structurally nontrivial crossover: one half holding is asymptotically inefficient by 25 percent on balanced bicliques, zero holding prevents meetings altogether, and the optimum scales as a harmonic-size cube root only when both parts grow, versus a constant on stars. This is a full classification and sharp asymptotic optimization, not a table recomputation.
